protocols.title: Acute Febrile Illness & Tropical Infections (तीव्र बुखार एवं संक्रामक रोग)
protocols.guideline_source: MoHFW Standard Treatment Guidelines (STG) - Acute Febrile Illness
protocols.clinical_focus: Determine exact duration, pattern (intermittent vs continuous), rigors, retro-orbital headache, rash, and urinary/GI symptoms.
targeted_questions_hi: बुखार कितने दिनों से है और क्या साथ में कंपकंपी (chills) या पसीना भी आता है?
क्या आंखों के पीछे दर्द, शरीर पर कोई लाल चकत्ते (rash), या उल्टी जैसी समस्या है?
क्या आपको सिरदर्द, जोड़ों में तेज दर्द या पेशाब में जलन महसूस हो रही है?
targeted_questions_en: How many days have you had fever, and does it come with chills or shivering?
Do you have pain behind your eyes, any skin rashes, or persistent nausea?
Are you experiencing severe joint pain, intense headache, or burning urination?
suggested_chips_hi: बदन और जोड़ों में तेज दर्द
आंखों के पीछे दर्द व उल्टी
red_flags: Fever lasting > 5 days without defervescence
Petechial rash, mucosal bleeding (bleeding gums/nose - suspect Dengue warning signs)
Persistent severe abdominal pain and persistent vomiting
Altered sensorium, extreme lethargy, or convulsion
protocols.safety_guidance: Encourage adequate oral hydration (ORS, coconut water, clean fluids). Avoid NSAIDs (aspirin, ibuprofen) until dengue is ruled out; paracetamol 500-650mg is safe for fever control.

protocols.title: Acute Chest Discomfort & Cardiovascular Triage (सीने में दर्द व हृदय आपातकालीन प्रोटोकॉल)
protocols.guideline_source: Cardiological Society of India (CSI) & MoHFW Emergency Triage Guidelines
protocols.clinical_focus: Evaluate central crushing or pressure sensation radiating to left arm, neck, or jaw; check for diaphoresis, dyspnea, and relation to exertion.
targeted_questions_hi: क्या सीने में भारीपन या दबाव महसूस हो रहा है जो बाएं हाथ, गर्दन या जबड़े की तरफ जा रहा है?
क्या चलने-फिरने पर यह तकलीफ बढ़ती है और साथ में ठंडा पसीना या घबराहट हो रही है?
क्या आपको पहले से हाई बीपी, शुगर या दिल की कोई बीमारी है?
targeted_questions_en: Is the pain a heavy crushing sensation radiating to your left arm, neck, or jaw?
Does the pain worsen with physical exertion, and do you feel cold sweating or dizziness?
Do you have a personal history of hypertension, diabetes, or previous heart conditions?
suggested_chips_hi: बाएं हाथ और जबड़े में दर्द
सांस फूल रही है और पसीना
गैस या जलन जैसा लगता है
red_flags: Central chest tightness or heavy pressure lasting > 15 minutes
Pain radiating to left arm, neck, shoulder, or jaw with diaphoresis
Chest pain accompanied by syncope, extreme lightheadedness, or sudden breathlessness
History of coronary artery disease with new or worsening resting pain
protocols.safety_guidance: IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Do not perform vigorous exertion. Patient requires urgent 12-lead ECG and immediate physician evaluation in emergency / triage room.

protocols.title: Respiratory Tract & Pulmonary Guidelines (श्वसन तंत्र एवं फेफड़े संबंधी दिशानिर्देश)
protocols.guideline_source: MoHFW National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP) & Indian Chest Society
protocols.clinical_focus: Assess cough duration (cough > 2 weeks warrants sputum examination for TB per NTEP), sputum characteristics, wheeze, nocturnal dyspnea, and stridor.
targeted_questions_hi: खांसी कितने दिनों से है—क्या यह सूखी है या बलगम भी आ रहा है?
क्या सांस लेते समय सीटी जैसी आवाज (wheezing) आती है या रात में सांस फूलती है?
क्या बलगम में खून (blood) आया है या पिछले कुछ हफ्तों में वजन घटा है?
targeted_questions_en: How long have you had this cough, and is it dry or producing phlegm?
Do you notice a whistling/wheezing sound when breathing, or shortness of breath at night?
Have you seen blood in your sputum, or experienced unexplained weight loss or evening fever?
suggested_chips_hi: सूखी खांसी और गले में खराश
red_flags: Inability to complete full sentences in one breath (acute severe asthma/COPD)
Stridor, cyanosis (bluish tint around lips/fingertips), SpO2 < 92%
Hemoptysis (coughing up fresh blood)
Cough persisting > 2 weeks with evening fever and night sweats (suspect Pulmonary TB)
protocols.safety_guidance: For patients with known asthma, check inhaler compliance and correct spacer technique. Warm water gargles and steam inhalation provide symptomatic relief for acute viral pharyngitis.

protocols.title: Gastrointestinal & Abdominal Triage (पेट एवं पाचन तंत्र प्रोटोकॉल)
protocols.guideline_source: Indian Society of Gastroenterology & MoHFW Clinical Management Guidelines
protocols.clinical_focus: Identify quadrant location of abdominal pain, relation to food intake, signs of dehydration from diarrhea/vomiting, and signs of surgical acute abdomen.
targeted_questions_hi: पेट में दर्द किस जगह हो रहा है—ऊपर (epigastric), नाभि के पास, या नीचे दाईं तरफ?
क्या उल्टी या दस्त की समस्या है, और आज कितनी बार दस्त हुए हैं?
क्या पेट में बहुत तेज असहनीय दर्द या छूने पर सख्त महसूस हो रहा है?
targeted_questions_en: Where is the pain located—upper abdomen, around the navel, or lower right side?
Are you experiencing vomiting or loose motions, and how many episodes today?
Is the abdominal pain severe and unbearable, or does the belly feel unusually rigid?
suggested_chips_hi: नाभि या नीचे दाईं तरफ दर्द
red_flags: Rigid, board-like abdomen with severe rebound tenderness (suspect Perforation/Peritonitis)
Hematemesis (vomiting blood or coffee-ground material) or Melena (black tarry stool)
Severe dehydration with sunken eyes, poor skin turgor, and low urine output
High fever with yellow discoloration of sclera/skin (acute cholangitis / severe hepatitis)
protocols.safety_guidance: Initiate Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) immediately for acute diarrhea. Avoid heavy greasy food. Do not administer strong NSAID analgesics for unexplained acute abdominal pain before clinical exam.

protocols.title: Neurological & Headache Guidelines (तंत्रिका तंत्र एवं सिरदर्द दिशानिर्देश)
protocols.guideline_source: Indian Academy of Neurology & Stroke Triage Standards
protocols.clinical_focus: Differentiate primary headaches from acute secondary red flags; screen for FAST stroke symptoms (Face droop, Arm drift, Speech difficulty, Time window).
targeted_questions_hi: क्या सिरदर्द अचानक बिजली की तरह तेज हुआ है या धीरे-धीरे बढ़ रहा है?
क्या चेहरे पर टेढ़ापन, हाथ-पैर में कमजोरी, या बोलने में तुतलाहट महसूस हो रही है?
क्या सिरदर्द के साथ उल्टी, गर्दन में अकड़न, या तेज रोशनी से परेशानी होती है?
targeted_questions_en: Did this headache start suddenly like a thunderclap, or has it built up gradually?
Have you noticed facial asymmetry, weakness in one arm or leg, or slurred speech?
Is the headache accompanied by vomiting, neck stiffness, or extreme sensitivity to light?
suggested_chips_hi: तनाव व नींद की कमी से
red_flags: FAST positive: Sudden facial droop, unilateral arm/leg weakness, or slurred speech (Acute Stroke - 4.5h window)
Sudden onset 'worst headache of life' (thunderclap headache - suspect Subarachnoid Hemorrhage)
Headache with fever and painful neck stiffness (suspect Meningitis)
New onset seizure or unexplained altered consciousness
protocols.safety_guidance: FAST positive patients require immediate emergency triage transfer for non-contrast brain CT scan. Keep patient sitting upright and calm.

protocols.title: Musculoskeletal & Orthopedic Guidelines (जोड़ों व हड्डियों के दर्द का प्रोटोकॉल)
protocols.guideline_source: Indian Orthopaedic Association & MoHFW Musculoskeletal STGs
protocols.clinical_focus: Assess mechanical vs inflammatory joint pain, morning stiffness duration, radiation down limbs, and trauma/fall history.
targeted_questions_hi: दर्द किस जोड़ या कमर में है, और क्या यह चलने-फिरने से बढ़ता है या सुबह सोकर उठने पर अकड़न रहती है?
क्या कमर का दर्द पैर के निचले हिस्से तक जाता है (sciatica) या पैर में सुन्नपन है?
क्या हाल ही में कोई चोट, फिसलकर गिरना, या भारी वजन उठाने की घटना हुई है?
targeted_questions_en: Which joint or spine area hurts, and is there prolonged morning stiffness exceeding 30 minutes?
Does back pain radiate down the leg (sciatica) or cause numbness in the foot/groin?
Did this pain start following a recent fall, sports injury, or heavy lifting?
suggested_chips_hi: कमर दर्द जो पैर तक जाए
सुबह उठने पर जोड़ों में अकड़न
चोट या मोच के बाद दर्द
red_flags: Back pain with bilateral leg weakness or bowel/bladder incontinence (suspect Cauda Equina Syndrome)
Hot, acutely swollen, erythematous single joint with fever (suspect Septic Arthritis)
Severe bone deformity or inability to bear weight after fall (suspect Acute Fracture)
Back pain in an elderly or osteoporotic patient following minor slip
protocols.safety_guidance: Encourage gentle range-of-motion as tolerated. Avoid sudden heavy lifting. Hot or cold fermentation depending on acute vs chronic stage.

protocols.title: Metabolic & Chronic Non-Communicable Diseases (मधुमेह एवं उच्च रक्तचाप प्रोटोकॉल)
protocols.guideline_source: Research Society for Study of Diabetes in India (RSSDI) & National NCD Guidelines
protocols.clinical_focus: Review known duration of diabetes/hypertension, medication adherence, recent blood glucose/HbA1c/BP readings, and screen for micro/macrovascular complications.
targeted_questions_hi: क्या आप पहले से बीपी या शुगर की दवा नियमित ले रहे हैं, और आखिरी बार रीडिंग कब चेक कराई थी?
क्या ज्यादा प्यास लगना, बार-बार पेशाब आना, या पैरों में जलन व सुन्नपन रहता है?
क्या पैरों में कोई घाव (diabetic foot ulcer) है जो ठीक नहीं हो रहा?
targeted_questions_en: Are you taking your prescribed diabetes or BP medications regularly, and when was your last check?
Have you experienced increased thirst, frequent urination at night, or burning in feet?
Do you have any non-healing sores or ulcers on your feet?
suggested_chips_hi: बीपी की दवा चल रही है
red_flags: Systolic BP > 180 mmHg or Diastolic > 110 mmHg with headache/blurred vision (Hypertensive Emergency)
Hypoglycemic symptoms: Tremors, diaphoresis, sudden confusion, palpitations relieved by sugar
Deep, infected or necrotic diabetic foot ulcer
Fruity breath odor with rapid deep breathing and confusion (suspect Diabetic Ketoacidosis)
protocols.safety_guidance: Never stop antihypertensive or antidiabetic medicines abruptly without physician direction. Inspect feet daily for cuts or sores.

protocols.title: Ministry of AYUSH Integrative Health Guidelines (आयुष एवं पारंपरिक स्वास्थ्य दिशानिर्देश)
protocols.guideline_source: Ministry of AYUSH Standard Treatment Guidelines & Integrative OPD Protocols
protocols.clinical_focus: Record prior use of indigenous/herbal formulations, dietary habits (Ahara), daily routine (Dinacharya), and assess primary Agni (metabolic fire) status.
targeted_questions_hi: क्या आप इस परेशानी के लिए कोई काढ़ा, चूर्ण, या आयुर्वेदिक घरेलू नुस्खा ले रहे हैं?
आपकी भूख, पाचन और नींद की क्या स्थिति है—क्या पेट साफ रहता है?
क्या आप प्राकृतिक एवं संतुलित आहार (पथ्य-अपथ्य) के नियमों का पालन कर रहे हैं?
targeted_questions_en: Are you currently taking any Ayurvedic decoction (Kadha), Churna, or home remedy for this condition?
How is your digestion, appetite, and sleep quality—is bowel evacuation regular?
Would you like an integrative physician review combining standard clinical care with AYUSH dietary guidance?
suggested_chips_hi: काढ़ा या चूर्ण ले रहे हैं
red_flags: Suspected heavy metal toxicity from unstandardized classical preparations
Delaying essential emergency allopathic care (e.g. chest pain, severe infection) for home remedies
Severe electrolyte imbalance from excessive purgative herbal preparations
protocols.safety_guidance: Always disclose all herbal, Ayurvedic, and OTC formulations to your consulting doctor to avoid herb-drug interactions.
